stem: Which answer is supported by the passage that includes “Sam opened his lunch box and found only rice.”?
options: The choices were curry rice, tomato noodles, vegetable dumplings, and chicken soup.
Ben gave him half of the chicken, and Lily shared some fruit.
Students asked for smaller portions or shared unopened fruit with others.
Some students gave it food, but the guard told them not to.
